text: Petroleum and natural gas engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that focuses on the exploration, development, transportation, processing, and utilization of petroleum and natural gas resources. Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to efficiently, safely, and environmentally soundly extract oil and gas resources from underground and deliver them to end-users". As a pillar discipline in the energy field, it not only involves the development of underground oil and gas reservoirs that reach depths of several thousand meters, but also encompasses pipeline transportation spanning thousands of miles. It is a crucial link connecting "underground resources" and "industrial energy".
